title: Effects of chemical pre-treatment on structure and property of polyacrylonitrile based pre-oxidized fibers
journal: Journal of Engineered Fibers and Fabrics
source_material_form_LOI_raw: samples were made by twisting fibers
TGA_specimen_preparation: Finely powdered aliquots of the prepared OPFHA-MEA fibers; no identical TG and LOI geometry asserted.
LOI_specimen_preparation: Twisted prepared fibers according to FZ/T 50017-2011.
treatment_chemistry: hydroxylamine hydrochloride followed by monoethanolamine, then pre-oxidation in air
treatment_method: Commercial Jilin PAN fibers washed with alcohol. Treat in 40 g/L hydroxylamine hydrochloride at 80 C for 2 h; adjust pH to 5 with anhydrous sodium carbonate; wash and dry. Then reflux in 30 mg/L monoethanolamine at 90 C for 2 h with stirring; cool and wash with deionized water at 70 C. Apply unspecified tension and pre-oxidize in air from 170 C to 250 C at 1 C/min, hold 10 min. Source concentration 30 mg/L retained without correction.
